definitions.explanation: The management and administration of money and assets in organizations, especially companies and governments.

examples.japanese: {財務|ざいむ}{諸表|しょひょう}を{分析|ぶんせき}する。
{彼|かれ}は{財務|ざいむ}{部門|ぶもん}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: He works in the finance department.

examples.japanese: {財務|ざいむ}{状況|じょうきょう}が{悪化|あっか}している。

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {財務部|ざいむぶ}: finance department
- {財務諸表|ざいむしょひょう}: financial statements
- {財務状況|ざいむじょうきょう}: financial condition
- {財務省|ざいむしょう}: Ministry of Finance
- {財務大臣|ざいむだいじん}: Minister of Finance

RELATED TERMS:
- {経理|けいり}: accounting (day-to-day bookkeeping)
- {会計|かいけい}: accounting (broader sense)
- {財政|ざいせい}: public finance; fiscal matters

DIFFERENCE:
- {財務|ざいむ}: Corporate/organizational finance
- {財政|ざいせい}: Government/public finance
